_comment: Add a newsletter by appending an entry. 'structure': itemized = split into discrete items; essay = one record per issue. 'spec' names the section of references/PARSE_SOURCES.md documenting the format.

sources.name: TLDR
sources.notes: Multiple daily editions. Real text/plain body with a [n] footnote link map. Filed under a label, NOT the inbox — never scope with in:inbox.

sources.name: The Flyover
sources.notes: ~2 sends/day; roughly one per day is a whole-issue ad. Parse from FULL_CONTENT HTML — section names live in heading image alt text. Multiple bullets can share one physical line. Bullet titles are synthesized from the opening clause; end them at a sentence/clause boundary, never a hard char cut.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.notes: Two sub-editions: 'Following' (no-reply@, daily) and 'Subscriber Update' (subscriptions@, irregular). Digests end with empty item skeletons that must be dropped.

sources.name: Keychain
sources.notes: 'The Daily Fast 5' — exactly 5 items per issue, weekdays only, asterisk-row delimited. SendGrid encrypted links are NOT resolvable; stored but flagged.

excluded.name: Mailbrew
excluded.reason: link-only items with no summaries; it is a digest of the user's own inbox
